steps.title: Define Project Requirements
steps.description: Design a dark-themed modern calculator app with rounded soft buttons, clear readable display typography, and real-time computation features.

steps.title: Configure App Metadata
steps.description: Setup app-meta.json declaring the application name and correct package ID structures.

steps.title: Setup Build Settings
steps.description: Define build configurations in build.gradle targeting Android SDK 34 and Java 8 features compatibility.

steps.title: Declare Manifest file
steps.description: Establish application parameters, main entry screen, screen orientation lock, and launcher activities inside AndroidManifest.xml.

steps.title: Design Brand Palette
steps.description: Create dark and vibrant custom colors including display shades, primary functional buttons, and specialized operator indicators.

steps.title: Declare String resources
steps.description: Define localization strings and accessibility label metadata.

steps.title: Define Custom Themes
steps.description: Establish base styles inherited from system dark styles omitting default action bar.

steps.title: Design Number Button Selectors
steps.description: Generate highly-responsive shape selectors for numeric keypad inputs.

steps.title: Design Operator Selectors
steps.description: Construct beautiful orange interactive button background states for division, addition, and other calculation operators.

steps.title: Design Function Selectors
steps.description: Define tactile grey selectors for utility actions such as All Clear, Parentheses, and Percentage.

steps.title: Design Equal Button Selectors
steps.description: Create distinctive emerald green background states for processing output trigger.

steps.title: Assemble Main UI Structure
steps.description: Create modern weighted grid layout in activity_main.xml featuring a seamless flow display area and nested keypad groups.

steps.title: Program Application Control System
steps.description: Develop state variables, event processors, UI updates, and an integrated real-time recursive expression solver in MainActivity.java.

steps.title: Building Modern Calculator
steps.description: Compile project elements, verify package namespace declarations, and generate the executable package.
